basic_info.description: This well-maintained duplex is located in a very desirable section of the Outer Sunset, just a half block from Golden Gate Park, a couple blocks from Ocean Beach and the new Sunset Dune's Park. The upper two-level unit features a remodeled kitchen and an open floor plan between the kitchen and dining room with ocean views. This level also has a living room, office, and bathroom. The upper floor of this unit has two bedrooms, one with ocean views. The lower unit offers two bedrooms, one bathroom, a living room, and a kitchen that flows out onto the rear deck with views of the shared yard, complete with an outdoor shower for rinsing off after a day at the beach. Whether you're an investor looking for a valuable addition to your portfolio or an owner-user who wants additional income, this property presents a rare opportunity in a sought-after location. In The Zone, just steps from all the best that the Irving and Judah commercial corridors have to offer.
